setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: A new empty project that has just started: stopped, Record off, channel 1 selected and no step held. The Channel editor is showing: its header reads NOTE MASKS CH01. The first step visits the page keys before you hold a step.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap each page key in turn and watch the header follow. Scale (4,8) opens the Scale Editor, SCALE SLOT 01. Pattern (5,8) cycles Trig, Note, then Velocity: three taps reach PATTERN VELOCITY PAT01 CH01. Song (6,8) opens SONG PLAYBACK SONG 01. Channel (3,8) brings you back to NOTE MASKS CH01.
steps.title: Visit the page keys

steps.caption: Tap channel 3 at (3,1). The header now reads NOTE MASKS CH03.
steps.title: Select channel 3

steps.caption: Press and hold step 5 at (5,4). The header reads CH03 ST05: ST05 means step 5 of the selected channel. While the step is held, edits on this Masks page apply to step 5 only.
steps.title: Hold a step

steps.caption: With step 5 still held, turn E2 to the Note cell and turn E3 one detent up. The Note cell changes from X to C-2 and the header still reads CH03 ST05, so the edit belongs to step 5 only.
steps.title: Edit while the step is held

steps.caption: Let go of step 5. The header drops back to NOTE MASKS CH03 and edits apply to the whole channel again.
steps.title: Release the step

steps.caption: Look at the Note cell now. It still reads X, the channel's own value, so the C-2 you set lives on step 5 alone.
steps.title: The channel value is unchanged

steps.caption: Turn E1 to open Channel tasks, scroll to Clock and press K3. The Clock page for CH03 is showing.
steps.title: Open the Clock page

steps.caption: Press and hold step 9 at (9,4). While it is held the screen switches to that step's Masks, header NOTE MASKS CH03 ST09, whichever page you were on.
steps.title: Hold a step from the Clock page

steps.caption: Release step 9. The screen returns to the Clock page, the page you were on before you held the step.
steps.title: Return to the parent screen
